name: Angelic Sonata
source:
Angelic Sonata is a Visual Novel takes place in Okinawa, Japan. The protagonist is Naoto, a normal high school student. However, his life is not normal anymore when he met with a mysterious girl sleeping on a tree. Who is she? Why is she here? The answer is up to you to discover.

[Edited from [url=http://renai.us/game/AS.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
